name: If There's a Hell Below We're All Going to Go

podcast.body: This song is noted by funk historian Ricky Vincent as a powerful response to the killing of Fred Hampton, sharing a similar context and influence with The Chi-Lites' "For God's Sake, Give More Power to the People." It served as a popular acknowledgment of the Black Panther Party's impact and resonance with the black community. "Much like if there's a hell below, we're all going to go by Curtis Mayfield."
